notes.title: CONCLUDED Emergency Maintenance - July 11, 2024
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36929673/69e066ba33cb7f22c80b185f67ce3e70aad5992f.png[/img]

Greetings Atlantians!

We are pleased to announce that the emergency maintenance has concluded and servers are now up and running!

Here is a summary of what has been fixed
• Vacance Enchantment Stone can now be used to Power Enhance any Pegasus Weapons
• Vacance Enchantment Stone can now be used to Power Enhance any Pegasus Armors
• Vacance Enchantment Stone can now be used to Power Enhance any Dark Pegasus Weapons

• Vacance Enchantment Stone can now be used to Power Enhance any Judgment Weapons
• Vacance Enchantment Stone can now be used to Power Enhance any Judgment Armors
• Fixed an issue that prevented Sage Crescent Glaive from registered on the Collection Book
• Fixed an issue that prevented Shadow Blade from registered on the Collection Book
• Fixed an issue that prevented Natasha’s Shadow Blade from registered on the Collection Book

Everyone can now log in to the game. We thank you for your patience and understanding!

Happy Gaming~
Regards,
Atlantica VALOFE Team

notes.title: Emergency Maintenance - April 12, 2024
notes.content:
Attention Atlantians!

We would like to inform everyone that we will be having an emergency maintenance for today April 12, 2024, to address some issues in the game especially the following:

[list]
[*] Missing Cherry Blossom Event Items and Crafting Recipes
[*] Daily Repeatable Quests Not Resetting
[/list]

This EMT may last up to 2 hours. We hope for your extended patience as we resolve this as quickly as possible.

Regards,

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36929673/c351ee476882536734a64c8e84a1139901d54fbc.png[/img]
Developer Note: Changes to Mercenary Auto-Battle Feature

Hello, this is the Atlantica development team. We would like to inform you about changes to the Mercenary Auto-Battle feature in this update.
Starting from this update, the Mercenary Auto-Battle feature will no longer be available. We would like to explain the reasons behind this change.
We hope that all players enjoy the game in a fair environment. The use of macros undermines the fairness of the game and can render our efforts and time futile.
Therefore, we have decided to remove the Mercenary Auto-Battle feature to prevent such unfair activities.
However, we are aware that this decision may cause inconvenience to some players. In response, we plan to provide various items related to auto-battle through events and other means. Through this, we hope that all players experience minimal inconvenience while enjoying the game and have a more enjoyable experience together.
Thank you.

notes.title: Details on the Druid Changes last January 10
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36929673/ce37504548996571774264f4d5a920a3b242c10c.png[/img]

Hello there, Atlantians!

We would like to share with you a message from our development team regarding the recent update on Druid for both NA and EU Servers that was applied last January 10.

"Greetings, Atlantians!

I work in the Atlantica Development Team and I was in charge of the recent Druid revamp. Please call me MM.

The world of Atlantica is so wide and there are so many attractive mercenaries. We can travel around the world to meet them and listen to their stories but, many mercenaries are not used and only a few mercenaries are chosen.

The problems of old mercenaries are mostly the same:
1. Their magic is too weak
2. There is too little magic available

These problems make them useless. For now, we chose Druid, a friend who is easy to hire and has been by our side for a long time.

[Forest Prison]
Added combo with new magic. For the combo, it was necessary to change the existing effects, and as a result, it became a different magic than the existing ones. Unfortunately, the stun effect was deleted, but it was inevitable.

[Beast's Soul]
This is a buff skill. However, it was too ineffective for the cost of consuming the turn.
So I changed it to passive and adjusted the effect. This will have some impact on Axe-Main as well.

[Beast Claw]
Magic to deal additional damage in case of a basic attack. It is similar to that of Spartacus. Considering the concept of the axe, I thought it would be better to have powerful damage but with the trigger rate set a little lower.

[All Out]
It's active magic. If you leave [Forest Prison] on the 1st line unattended, you may regret it.

After the patch, some users are already using Druid. I've revamped Druid for the Atlantians who don't have Spartacus. But I know there are Atlantians who are using both Druid and Spartacus in their formation.

I hope this rework will make Druid more attractive and give you more choices when you set up your formations. I also hope that these changes will bring a new meta to Atlantica.

Of course, one or two mercenaries are not enough. Therefore, we plan to continue to improve old mercenaries. 

Please look forward to the next revamp. See you again!"

There you have it, everyone! We thank you for all your support and we hope to see you in the next updates.

Regards, 
Atlantica VALOFE Team

notes.title: Seasonal Server - Season 2 Announcement!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36929673/73e626237bebf40d6acf223708ca2d3d57c77dc3.jpg[/img]

Greetings Atlantians!

The battle unravels once more in the world of Atlantica as Season 2 goes live this October 26, 2023. Battle your way through as Season 2 will be bringing in some changes and improvements. A new adventure begins!

To kick things off, everyone will be starting anew and fresh on Season 2. Square off or form out with other Atlantians who will also be participating in this new journey.

Note: All Character progress and items prior to Season 2 will be deleted.

[h1]Season 2 Changes and Improvements[/h1]

Season 2 will be bringing in several changes and improvements.

    Diary Activity cap increased
    Blessing License Support from Level 1 to Level 140
    Atlas Ore Enhancement Adjustments
    Enhancement probability has been increased

The Following Magic Skills listed below can now be learned through the use of Atlas Ore
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36929673/ef1721e6f373e09b80f7a0928f49570e308f85a4.png[/img]

Hourly Reward Improvements
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36929673/d3871ebf8bf64ab08064373d2abfbca888535f6d.png[/img]

New Mercenary Skin Added

    Sage King Arthur: Knight King of the Dawn
    Dark King Arthur: Knight King of the Abyss
    Jeon Woo-chi: Heavenly Taoist
    Gigas: Steam Golem

Crafting Adjustments

    Weapon and Armor Crafting manufacturing level has been decreased by half
    Weapon and Armor Crafting manufacturing workload has increased by 1.5 times
    Changed Weapon and Armor manufacturing materials

Equipment Collection Set Grade Adjustment

    Change the Collection Set Requirement Grade of Level 1 to 130 equipment to *(All Grade)

Exchange Point Store Adjustments

Brilliant Acong Exchange Item Change
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36929673/db06dc5f8b3bd350650bc643347405be32b7c5de.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36929673/e840839eeaff57437310a5faea9a54dc56a3c4f5.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36929673/8181474b9763f2ec8befef89dfced01cab3bd185.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36929673/9085d760e3bdf7a64511ad3c18fb76c34558eaba.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36929673/824d03ae173864f1a151d4788b5452096354ecdb.png[/img]

Art Gallery Guide Acong NPC Exchange
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36929673/f0f821f84ac84e6840f3e7f55ffc4f7a4c2886a6.png[/img]

Manager Nimrod NPC Exchange
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36929673/0dd948ae3e87e33aee1652b5fa49f38f39d8accf.png[/img]

[h1]Seasonal Item Mall[/h1]

Seasonal Item Mall will have its price listing adjusted and as well introducing a few new items for this Season! We would to inform everyone that starting today and moving forward, all Seasonal Item Mall listing will have a [SS] tagged before the item name to notify they are Seasonal Server Only items.

Please stay tuned for further announcements!
~Atlantica VALOFE Team

notes.title: Atlantica Day - June 2023
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36929673/cfe7587b86cbcf2e78adc91fb4d72d2450e12e4e.jpg[/img]

Natasha has come a long way ever since her release and it's safe to say that she's had such a warm welcome~

A durable assassin able to dish out damage and follow the thematic of a vengeful mercenary; various builds, team compositions and certain theories have formed just by having her around on your or your friend's roster!

For your continuous support for Atlantica (and to make up for the numerous connection issues) we will be having a special AO Week setting especially for you.

[u][b]Duration:[/b][/u] [b]May 25 - May 31, 2023[/b] (PST Time)


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36929673/6c81d22b8660edd0e890fb56bc7ce6c14701df53.jpg[/img]

Get ready and get excited! It’s that time of the month again. Atlantica Day is here!

[u][b]Duration:[/b][/u] [b]June 1 - June 8, 2023[/b] (PST Time)

[h3]Atlantica Day Event Buffs[/h3]

1. Resting EXP. Boost 300% up
2. Diary EXP. Boost 300% up
3. Winner Gift Box Event
4. Jackpot Hourly Raffle (AT Day Jackpot Gift)
5. Party EXP Multiplier x2 and x3
6. EXP Bonus Time 300%
7. Crafting EXP 200%
8. Battle Buffs (Attack Power and Def +20%)
9. AT Day Sale (Mercenary, Legion, Books, and Atlas Ores)
10. Atlas Ore Enhancement discount -20%

[h3]Atlantica Day Coupons[/h3]

Aside from the Gift Boxes, you can get the [[b]Atlantica Day Coupon[/b]] for every hour that you are online. The number of coupons will increase per hour and everyone can earn up to 6 coupons and a Honey Jar Key! These coupons can be exchanged for weapons to the Atlantacong NPCs located in Rome!

[h3]Atlantica Day Giveaway[/h3]

We'll be giving out free goodies this weekend! Be sure to log into the game to receive the rewards.

[b]Giveaway Duration: June  2 - 8, 2023[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36929673/8913aee58763c0982d0a89f407ac20b69e1f66a1.png[/img]

Be sure to log in for those bonus EXP and buffs!
See you in-game and have a great week!

[i]~Atlantica Team[/i]

notes.title: Introducing the [Special] Warehouse!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36929673/28624005871e52fd7386c6414356732390e3fe93.png[/img]
[h3]Introducing the SPECIAL Warehouse![/h3]
Equip gems through the Special Warehouse system! This warehouse slot allows you to relieve some space in your inventory full of gem items.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36929673/47514ba8260f103de15663af6a3fd1e6bbafe3de.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36929673/d8fe019eb5c802617b578d96839b3ebdbfb0e23c.png[/img]
[b]Simply drag your Gems into the Special Warehouse slot and equip it![/b]

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/ybboKRNnNLBkOePhBC/giphy.gif[/img]

To activate the Special Warehouse slot, you must have a [b][Special] Warehouse Scroll[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36929673/330656c431798a45aa2412ee6b1be8c7bcbc8694.png[/img]

[b]Activation Window:[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36929673/5e06bc8947fd5d587d8715507e555cebdffe6dbd.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36929673/06e2e166c9ba8bf9a8f490e69110a410e8d9a8ca.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Special Warehouse functions as a normal warehouse slot but with an added feature of equipping gems. You can still store any item in the Special Warehouse slot.
[*] You can only activate the slot if you have a [Special] Warehouse Scroll
[*] You cannot use a regular Warehouse Scroll to activate the Special Warehouse feature.
[*] Equipped gems in the warehouse and in the inventory does not stack and will still be limited to 3 per character.
[*] You can still equip gems in the inventory as long as it has not yet reached the 3 limit mark.
[/list]
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/CKYbTGvl00nQrdwZtM/giphy.gif[/img]

[i]~ Atlantica VALOFE Team[/i]

notes.title: New Mercenary - Natasha
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305565/7c7f1968c824912c2f43d318f3dc67aa5c707875.jpg[/img]

Assassins …
They are all hired guns, who ensure that the kill is well worth their paycheck. Their aim is well sharpened, their blades are honed keen, and their elusiveness, perfected.

“All they ever do is kill”

…but what happens when the same assassin, is driven by a strong sense of vengeance? One who lives and breathes exacting vengeance on those who have shaped their lives into madness?

That is none other than ‘NATASHA’ an assassin driven by her vengeance on those who have ruined her familys lives. Raised to kill and only kill, Natasha is built to never stop until she secures her targets heads. With strong tenacity and precise strikes, she is not one to be underestimated.

Natasha falls under the knight class, with a dual-blade weapon type. Natasha specializes in dishing out tons of damage and making sure her targets are weakened enough for a landing blow. As ‘Plan B’ after a failed kill, she can disengage safely boosting her defensive capabilities when focused upon.

[u][b][h2]Skills Preview:[/h2][/b][/u]

[h3][b]Shadow Strike[/b][/h3]
Has a chance of summoning a shadow illusion, that deals additional damage whenever Natasha attacks.

 [img]https://media.giphy.com/media/oFzbJLomOD3gNhX1se/giphy.gif[/img]

[h3][b]Shadows Mark[/b][/h3]
Marks targets in a row using her mastery of debilitating shadows. Dealing damage, weakening their defenses and dealing damage per turn.

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/zJFOE5lddb6bgebcAW/giphy.gif[/img]

[h3][b]Blood Oath[/b][/h3]
Natasha will not stop until everyone is eliminated. Reduces incoming damage from attacks and gains resistance.

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/z4kfUHb3aioryJV33L/giphy.gif[/img]
 
[h3][b]Avenger[/b][/h3]
Empowered by the spirit of vengeance, Natashas offensive capabilities have been improved. Increasing her Attack Power, Critical, Evasion Rate and Multi-hit Rate.
 
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/9Oa7FmC6M9dcDnE1Rq/giphy.gif[/img]

Recruit the Assassin today!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305565/a3a0f063d9254c9dfc8ad0a46a7c585806833e57.png[/img]

[i]
Of course, she does not hire for cheap…[/i]

notes.title: Intense! Thanksgiving 2022
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36929673/4ab64034a0b474555c066cc76a10ba0577b2a173.jpg[/img]

Thanksgiving is a celebration to be thankful to all the blessings received this year. For Chang An, it is a festival of getting a good sweat and be rewarded for your patience and efforts!

Introducing the "Intense! Training Camp" ! Spar with fellow trainees and wooden dummies and hone your skills! Rack up EXP and much more!

[b]Event Duration[/b]
[i]From the time of the update  - December 08, 2022 (PST)[/i]

[b]Getting Started[/b]
1. You must need an Intense! Training Card to enter the dungeon
2. 1 Training Card will give you 10 minutes to stay in the dungeon
3. Can obtain Intense! Training Card through the Hourly Login

[b]Hourly Login[/b]
Receive rewards as you play throughout the hours!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36929673/375ddc5d009ab01e24f2fa8b621238f21fa88b8a.png[/img]

[b]Intense! Training Camp[/b]
Teleport to the entrance by selecting the Intense! Training Camp at the events teleport section.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36929673/201658ed6120bcaedbbe45862ba4dd720727112c.png[/img]

In here you will encounter trainees and target dummies. A quick battle wth your gym mates can help you grow in to an absolute fighter!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36929673/fa7026edefe79ca3a4a02ece6509e7303ac14bb7.png[/img]

[b]Truly Intense![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36929673/4c6e5c18e2f4460c8785eb811d58c0198ad3a51d.png[/img]

[b]Bingo Event[/b]
Receive the Intense! Bingo Token and try your luck!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36929673/a5bc9e1458d044f9b932b7201185c8c705058af3.png[/img]

[b]Mechanics[/b]
1. Select the Bingo Token to open the Bingo Menu

notes.title: The Frozen Heart of Antark
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36929673/747e0609f3c1d5277a0ed206a972a42cab34a126.jpg[/img]

The frozen lands of Antark houses plenty of threats, all of which a common Atlantian have never dared face before. However, this doesn’t frighten curious researchers as they search for the secrets of Antark, its history and what treasures lie beneath the glaciers.
Prepare your mightiest warriors Atlantians, as we dive deep into the newest contents in the Antark Update!

[b]Entering Antark[/b]
1. Players must be Level 180 to proceed
2. Obtain the Key of Antark from the Grimm Brother's located outside the entrance
3. Getting the Key will require 1,000,000 Gold

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36929673/44ceff47c9b3099b1944c0e4635b2935b2b18a76.png[/img]

Once you've entered, you'll be met with an encampment where three personnels are stationed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36929673/3890cd3032f8042d7e3f326faf5fb8b8c6fd29ba.png[/img]

[b]New Quests (?)[/b]
Facilitator Gigas requests the eradication of a certain spiraling dungeon. You can speak to the machine in order to get started.

However, Aaron Reisner talks of a different area; a frozen dungeon. Speak to him to learn more of this research.

[i]Note: Both quests are weekly. (Resets on Monday)[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36929673/15c9f6c4556d54fb032a75f4cb540592727df451.png[/img]

[b]Antark Outpost Shop[/b]
The captain carries essential items to assist you in your journey through Antark. But what are such items?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36929673/b65ccb0fec89890488478b711124a1d592674b2b.png[/img]

[b]A Weapon Forged from Sin[/b]
Researchers discovered of an ancient weapon known to harness the power of sin, however obtaining them will require effort, time and your blood. Your crafting skills will be put to the test.
Such weapons will require a remnant of a sin in order to reach its full potential, IF, it really is its full potential....

[u]Requirements:[/u]

- A level of crafting that surpasses normality
- Materials from the many challenges found in Atlantica
- A brilliant stone, a place inhabited by Coyote's?
- A piece of ice, from Antark perhaps?
[i](Note: You can obtain such ice from abandoned chests)[/i]

[b]The New Areas[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36929673/e7834cb4a6c843a51eb101a9c62f08fc52d10201.png[/img]

The journey to the north will be perilous, but, that is up to you to decide...

[i]~ Atlantica VALOFE Team[/i]

notes.title: Pirate's Treasure Hunt
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36929673/81867d718c1ff22b9ab5670012b6203e2ebba0f9.jpg[/img]

Sometimes the deep sea holds plenty a treasure however so too does it house all manner of marine life. While the deep sea is already challenging in of itself, this does not stop our pirate-loving friend Wotello!

Join her on the all new Pirate’s Treasure Hunt! Enter the Carribean Seabed and obtain the Pirate’s Gold Coin! In exchange, obtain limited time event rewards and essentials.

Obtain enough and you may be able to recruit Pirate: Anne Bony!

[b]Event Duration:[/b] August 11 to September 8

[b]Event Mechanics:[/b]
1. Character must be at least level 50.
2. Obtain the Carribean Seabed Ticket from Pirate Fanatic Wotello or through the Hourly Giveaway
3. Battle monsters inside the dungeon to obtain the Pirate’s Gold Coin

[b]Event Location:[/b] [i]North America, Near Gardiners Island[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36929673/7a57f7af35031400775d1d804d3c99087159c250.png[/img]

NOTE: You can exchange Pirate's Gold Coin to Pirate Fanatic Wotello to obtain event limited rewards!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36929673/8f32dff09758e589d971095e7d9d8e41790da845.png[/img]

[b]Shop List:[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36929673/4c60bd40674ba3d84cdff352a5d300406b559538.png[/img]

Treasure awaits! Embark on the great pirate treasure hunt today!

[Added Effect] Buffs the entire ally formation with Def and Magic Def for 2 Turns. Cooldown 3 Turns. (Passive)

[Added Effect] Inflicts Guard Dispel and inflicts Silence.

[Added Effect] Increases Christine's Dexterity, Accuracy, and Critical.

[Added Effect] Recovers Action Power.

notes.title: Patch Notes - January 06 ,2022
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36929673/ec81403bf29ab25089aa8d819746d929e2e44e9f.jpg[/img]
Greetings Atlantians!

Welcome to another patch content breakdown for 461660! In today’s patch, we’ll be saying goodbye to another bygone year as well as Holy Town and Santa Villa, thanking all Atlantians who have saved them from the Christmas Raiders. Today we will also be greeting another year and New Year’s Acong knows just the way to celebrate!

On another news, word has it that a newcomer has arrived in the land of Atlantica! She was spotted carrying a guitar and overwhelming enemies with her high-impact melodies. Having her join your ranks would sure guarantee one grand concert!

This and more, in today’s patch update!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36929673/152e30e03223e21eff60f3858eb952314ca5491a.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36929673/5836335b3feb81b1be58b370bdb9b2d8a188d72c.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36929673/fe3106dea1737a6f4f1b688461340341695b6eac.png[/img]
[b]- Server Refresh[/b]

[b]- New Mercenary[/b]
: Musician – Sae
[i]
“Introducing SAE the newest guitarist to join Atlantica’s Mercenaries! Her tunes not only bolster her forces but also causes disruption on to her foes.

Through her melody alone, she can turn the tide of battle to your favor as long as you join her on her rockin grand debut!”[/i]

[b]- New Outfit Set[/b]
:  Gleeful Funny Set

[i]“VFUN’s very own Funny! To celebrate another year together, Funny arrives sharing his very own costume set! He comes bringing party favors as well as his signature Space Ship!
Comes in both Classic Funny Set and Gleeful Funny Set.”[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36929673/2f4a410c63addbab17dae422c0ce8291ed1d05a2.png[/img]
[b]- End of Christmas Event[/b]
: Holy Town and Santa Villa Closed
: Santahontas Shop stays until next update

[i]“And thus the Christmas Season comes to a close. Santa Villa and Holy Town will no longer be accessed. 

However, Santahontas will be staying, packing up her things and helping out in cleaning up Christmas decorations. Fortunately, she still has her items up for purchase. You can find her both near Holy Town and Santa Villa’s entrances.”
[/i]

[b]- Start of New Year’s Event[/b]
: New Shop NPC – New Year’s Acong
: New Dungeon – Cake World

[i]“New Year’s Acong has arrived bearing New Year’s treats for everyone who drops by his store! Along with him, comes the grand opening of Cake World where all Acongs band together to celebrate the New Years.

Be warned however as these Acongs go berserk as they celebrate, making them cause harm to other partygoers. You can obtain special cakes from the Acongs and exchange them over to New Year’s Acong to obtain said treats~!”[/i]

notes.title: Patch Notes - December 23 ,2021
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36929673/ec81403bf29ab25089aa8d819746d929e2e44e9f.jpg[/img]
Greetings Atlantians!

Welcome to another patch content breakdown for 461650! The Holiday Events keep on coming as the defense on Holy Town rages on. 

There has also been some word going on that a certain Jolly Old Fellow’s home has opened their doors welcoming Atlantians this Christmas! But alas, it has also become vulnerable to the raiders of Holy Town.

The defense of Christmas continues, but now we take the fight to Santa Villa!

On other news, a special bonus buff to celebrate another year together and more Christmas packages are headed your way!

This and more here on today’s patch content breakdown!

Please refer to the details below:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36929673/152e30e03223e21eff60f3858eb952314ca5491a.png[/img]

 Interacting now with Merchant Acong (Rome) will display an “All Items Have Been Sold Out” message instead of a normal chat window.”[/i]

[b]- Return of Santa Villa[/b]
: Return of Santa Vila Dungeon

[i]“Santa Villa makes a lite return welcoming any jolly good Atlantian to enter! However, Holy Town’s raiders have marched towards the humble Villa in the hopes to steal any Christmas goodies they can find!

Head on over to Santa Villa and defeat the wily raiders! New rewards await!”[/i]

[b][i]Note: 2 different Event Dungeon Tickets do not stack. Once Event Ticket A is used, you cannot use Event Ticket B unless the duration is finished[/i][/b]

[b]- Yong Yong’s Special Christmas Exchange[/b]

[i]“Yong Yong’s Christmas Exchange makes a return, bearing a hefty haul of gifts this Christmas! Still wondering to this day where he gets these special treasures…
Head on over to Rome and look for Yong Yong’s Event Shop!”[/i]

[b]- Year End Blessing 2021[/b]
:  Preload AO Day Settings (Dec. 24 to January 7)

[i]“As part of the Year End Blessing 2021, Atlantians will be able to take advantage of server buffs starting from Dec. 24 up until the first week of the year!
More details will be shared soon.”[/i]

[i]
“VIP looks for the star in you! Obtain the VIP Style Costume set and walk the red carpet, glimmering with awe and style!”[/i]

[b]- Blooming Flower Basket[/b]

[i]“Special flowers for you, a loved one or for you both! Obtain the Bouquet Decoration and harness the power of flora!”[/i]

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36929673/ec81403bf29ab25089aa8d819746d929e2e44e9f.jpg[/img]
Greetings Atlantians!

Welcome to another patch content breakdown for version 461630! Today’s patch says goodbye to Spooky Ghost Town as they close their doors once again preparing for their time to strike once more on to helpless passersby.

As a celebration for another triumphant victory against spooky monsters, Turkey Man has returned and prepared treats this Thanksgiving Season! 

A mysterious area has been discovered within a wintery forest. The area seems teeming with bones and necromancy. What does this new location entail to the local Atlantians? Tune in to find out more.

We will also tackle some new arrivals as well as fixes in today’s patch.

Please refer to the details below:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36929673/152e30e03223e21eff60f3858eb952314ca5491a.png[/img]

[b]- Server Refresh[/b]

[b]- New Area:[/b]
: Gravewoods

[i]“A mysterious snowy forest has been overrun by skeletons and necromancers. No one knows how they got there nor what their objective holds. Regardless, a new threat has been spotted and must be stopped as soon as possible! 

A ghoulish looking man has also been spotted hoarding treasures in which he claims comes from the deathly realm. Fortunately, he is willing to offer these goods for any adventurous Atlantian.
Head over to Gravewoods, stop a horde of skeletal warriors and obtain limited time rewards!”[/i]

[b]-New Items:[/b]
: Gondola Mount

[i]“Into the Venetian Canal we go as we ride the new Gondola Mount! Built solely for traversing the branching canals but now improved to become a battle ready mount.”[/i]

: Flowery Bouquet Decorations

[i]“Sometimes a bouquet is just what we need to cheer up a loved one or even ourselves. The smell of flowers is in the air, as you obtain the new Bouquet Decoration! Comes in Sunny Sunflower and Rose-filled.”[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36929673/2f4a410c63addbab17dae422c0ce8291ed1d05a2.png[/img]
[b]- End of Spooky Ghost Town Event[/b]

[i]“And thus the Spookiest Cemetery has closed its gates. Pumpkin Jack thanks all the heroic Atlantians for helping him on his mischievous mission and thus departs in to the night. 
Fortunately, as well, Halloween Specter will be staying to have Atlantians empty its bag of Halloween goodies. Once again we say goodbye to another Halloween Season making way for more festive activities!”[/i]

[b]- Start of Thanksgiving Event[/b]

[i]“Turkey Man returns followed by new goodies! He has flown back to Artisan District seeking the aid of Atlantians in his quest to make the ultimate Turkey!

Gain Thanksgiving exclusive rewards through Turkey Man’s Thanksgiving Puzzle Pieces and Merchant Acong’s Thanksgiving Event Shop at Rome Gate.

Rumor has it that there’s even more Turkey this Thanksgiving Season…”[/i]

[b]- Pre-loaded December AO Day Buffs[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36929673/ec81403bf29ab25089aa8d819746d929e2e44e9f.jpg[/img]
Greetings Atlantians!

Welcome to another patch content breakdown for version 461610!

Oktoberfest finally comes to a close and it seems Merchant Acong is going to keep his shop up while the event organizers clean up after the festival. A familiar haunted cemetery, as well, has opened its gates once again waiting for unsuspecting Atlantians to give them a good old spook! Rumor has it, the graveyard is located outside of Dublin.

On another news, it seems Merlin himself requests our aid on an assignment. His palace has finally opened its doors in the distant lands of Avalon, however, it is overflowing with cursed knights waiting to test their mettle. Aid the Grand Magus and he might grant you your just rewards.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36929673/152e30e03223e21eff60f3858eb952314ca5491a.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36929673/5836335b3feb81b1be58b370bdb9b2d8a188d72c.png[/img]

[b]- Server Refresh[/b]

[b]- New Mercenary Skins[/b]
: Bai Xian: Qipao
[i]“An elegant dress befitting of a high class maiden. Even Bai Xian stuns her fellow trainers as she wears the ornate gown.”[/i]

A thousand years ago, a powerful Dark Archmage have created a set of powerful relics. Such relics were imbued with arts of dark sorcery and such people who possessed them in history became legendary warrior and ruler in their own right. Warriors from across the land are looking for the relics to gain such unmeasurable power. Unbeknownst to many, such relics with dark magic would slowly corrupt its bearer and turn them into tyrants. Greetings Atlantians!

[i]"Introducing Guan Yu's deadly glaives! Enchanted spears wielded by the God Hand General himself. By obtaining these five spears you then harbor the power of the lightning dragon ready to electrify your enemies to their demise. 
To top it all off, the spears come in five color variants! Discover these five variants today!"[/i]

[i]"Successfully collected all five spears? You can stash all five of these on to your collection book! Check out your Collection Book for more details."

[h3]- Warring Dynasty Dungeon Update[/h3]
: Added 5 Spears as boss drop

Spooky Halloween Guide:
http://at.valofe.com/news/detail/4/652
[i]"It is time to say goodbye to the Twisted Bran Castle Event as they now shut its doors to get a way from the endless chaos that ensued over the month. Sorel Andersen will also be leaving Rome to take part in new scouting missions. The exchange shop, however, will stay for a while. Check on Merchant Acong for Twisted Bran goodies before he packs up and leave. 

Amidst the preparation, the Spooky Ghost Town returns and now opens their gate to celebrate Spooktober! The Runaway Pumpkin returns to cause another mishap as well. Looks like he needs your help with something. Look for him on the outskirts of Dublin and see what he has to offer."[/i]

notes.title: Know your game: Melee Mercenaries - Class C!
notes.content:
[i][u]We added Spanish, Portuguese and Simplified Chinese language for this article![/u][/i]

Welcome to the first series of Know Your Game! Today we will check on the Class C Melee Mercenaries that will help you on your journey from low to mid level (or retain them forever!).

So lets start and delve on the Class C Melee Mercenaries!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36929673/a151da12aa91fd75bf59b5b51fd61a53f67a8c0b.png[/img]

[h1]Beast Trainer[/h1]
[i]A mercenary with high vitality and summons creatures[/i]

The Beast Trainer is a mercenary who has high [Vitality] and she wields an Axe for her weapon. A Beast Trainer can endure attacks and tank damage in the frontline for your other mercenaries. Her attacks strike all enemies in a single row. She can use [Beast Summon] magic to deal damage to an entire formation.

[b]Type[/b]
Class C: Reaver Mercenary – Can attack up to three opponents in the same row at close range. She commands an army of creatures to fight while atop her tiger. She breaks enemy defenses with her axe and can endure enemy attacks with her high health.

[b]Skills / Magic[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36929673/17b61bc3eab9800820f26d5f6cf6f9f944e36ff8.png[/img]

[b]Beast Summon[/b] - Summons beasts to inflict damage on all opponents in a formation.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36929673/d93cec9d32144bd4d7f3dce7dab62ad553fd780a.png[/img]

[b]Exorcist[/b]
[i]A mercenary with ability to disable opposing staff mercenaries and providing support to allied staff mercenaries[/i]

The Exorcist is a mercenary who specializes in disabling opposing staff mercenaries and buffing your own staff mercenaries. He wields a sword for his weapon. An Exorcist is vital in anti-mage formations and supporting staff-centric formations. His attack can only strike one enemy in a single attack. He can use [Mana Burn], [Mana Seal] and [Seal Staff] to easily deal with enemy staff mercenaries.

[b]Type[/b]
Class C: Knight Mercenary – Can attack on opponent at close range. A menace in PvP and he can use his magic to disable and counter opposing staff mercenaries.

[b]Skills / Magic[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36929673/abb41f13c30ed684869119863535425e52e9b43e.png[/img] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36929673/d07444a36de33d2f366bc22c4c7007a7be8979fa.png[/img] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36929673/fb2df4e0845d32ed1c2f2c27b22773993b991ab0.png[/img] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36929673/54b0614ce3100a1a2a7d914fb13a39faa2830790.png[/img]

[b]Mana Seal[/b] – Drain’s an enemy’s magic points and converts it into damage.

[b]Seal Staff[/b] – Prevents staff-wielding enemies from using skills.

[b]Mana Burn[/b] – Decreases the attack power of staff-wielding enemies.

[b]Speed Cast[/b] – Increases your staff mercenaries’ attack power and slightly regenerate health at the start of each combat phase.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36929673/2a593788915cfbb8824ccc5745690923d61ee4a4.png[/img]

[b]Punisher[/b]
[i]A versatile mercenary that weakens his enemies and protects his allies[/i]

The Punisher is a mercenary who is versatile who can un-stun an ally, deal AoE damage and debuff opposing bow users. He equips a Power Saw for his weapon. A Punisher can easily fit into various formations. His attack strikes all enemies in a single row. He can use [Broken Arrows] to debuff an opposing bow-wielding enemy.

[b]Type[/b]
Class C: Berserker Mercenary – Can attack enemies in a row at close range. He tears his enemies apart with his power saw. He weakens his enemies and protects his allies.

[b]Skills / Magic[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36929673/555fd2054754c268eaaa66076921c9c37dd7532d.png[/img] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36929673/d10eacb47d606f737f07fe5f24f773631228c903.png[/img] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36929673/3a716ed57c0236e9f31e332054db1efd5adf9681.png[/img]

[b]Broken Arrows[/b] – Decreases attack power and vitality bow-wielding mercenaries and seals their magic.

[b]Power Saw Raid[/b] – Jump dive into an enemy dealing damage on the enemy formation.

[b]Sacrificial Awakening[/b] – Using his own health, removes a stun from allies.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36929673/4e7f6546172906f3db0316b35276d58b3de08c7d.png[/img]

[h1]Lady Knight[/h1]
[i]A mercenary specialized in tanking damage[/i]

The Lady Knight is a mercenary who has high [Defense] and she wields a Sword for her weapon. A Lady Knight can tank damage in order to protect allies behind her. Her attack strikes only one enemy in a single attack. She can use [Light Slash] magic to deal high damage to one enemy and can be combined with Oracle’s [Vortex] to make it explode into a mighty [Divine Slash]

[b]Type[/b]
Class C: Knight Mercenary – Can attack on opponent at close range. Sworn to protect with her sword and shield, she can tank damage on the frontline to protect her allies in the rear of the formation.

[b]Skills / Magic[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36929673/7222c87b1aad0efa9c44606435f0ed620a8a843d.png[/img]

[b]Light Slash[/b] – Slashes the enemy with a sword of light. When combined with the Oracle's Vortex, it explodes into a mighty Divine Slash.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36929673/4c5aa5057c8150e0929e5c20c1dca081bb89ffe9.png[/img]

[h1]Northern Viking[/h1]
[i]A mercenary that freeze enemies with his magic[/i]

The Northern Viking is a mercenary who has high [Strength] and [Defense] and he wields an Axe for his weapon. A Northern can easily disable an enemy’s mercenaries with his magic. His attack can strike up to three enemies in a single row. He can use [Broken Arrows] to debuff an opposing bow-wielding enemy.

[b]Type[/b]
Class C: Reaver Mercenary – Can attack enemies in a row at close range. He can disable enemies in a formation by freezing them with his magic which makes them easy pickings for his allies. His high [Strength] and [Defense] makes an ideal frontline tank.

[b]Skills / Magic[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36929673/c12a6a3d19020f0af16ecf06e7ac2439aad76534.png[/img] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36929673/dca4733dce4ceb6db2ab0bccffd0ea811fdb50f7.png[/img] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36929673/ff01d91d0c71a033b659b0a46cf0544376598ab6.png[/img]

[b]Deadly Strike[/b] – While on the verge of death, strike a blow of desperation. Puts a strain on his action power, delaying his turn.

[b]Freezing Axe[/b] – Releases a blast of ice that freezes an enemy for some time.

[b]Ice Ridge Axe[/b] – Locks up enemies in an ice ridge by drawing power from the core of the Earth.

So who's your favorite Class C Melee Mercenary? Each of them can be used for PvP or PvE, the choice is yours!

Stay tuned for more [b]Know Your Game[/b] posts!
See you all soon!

[b]Atlantica Global Team[/b]
